Description.name: Rare Whajje
Description.description: Inspired by frequent contact with a certain bubble-blowing Seasonal, the Rare one of this Wublin has been reimagined in that Monster's partial likeness. Lagomorph ears and a white and purple striped torso evoke the pre-eminent detective who was instrumental in revealing Electricity's landmark island in the first place - Whajje think about that?
